reference: Uniform periodic 2-D and 3-D grids. On background 2^52, one third of cells have mean offset 1. Its mean square about the specified background is 1/3 and its variance is 2/9. A product linear Legendre mode with coefficient 1/4 adds 1/(16*3^d) to the mean square. Multiply by domain measure/2 for the exact fluctuation energy.
